tasks.contract: Stream pod log lines with return_type str in order. Each line must decode, gate empty (end-of-log stops), then dispatch str fast-path. The bug checks empty only for reconnect so an ended str stream reconnect-loops instead of stopping.
tasks.body:
import asyncio
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock
from kubernetes_asyncio.watch import Watch
async def main():
    fake_resp = AsyncMock()
    fake_resp.content.readline = AsyncMock(side_effect=[b'log_line_1', b'',
        AssertionError('readline called after end-of-log: reconnect loop')])
    fake_resp.release = Mock()
    fake_api = Mock()
    fake_api.read_namespaced_pod_log = AsyncMock(return_value=fake_resp)
    fake_api.read_namespaced_pod_log.__doc__ = ':param follow:\n:type follow: bool\n:rtype: str'
    w = Watch()
    seq = []
    async with w:
        async for e in w.stream(fake_api.read_namespaced_pod_log):
            seq.append(e)
    print('log_sequence', seq)
    assert seq == ['log_line_1'], seq
asyncio.run(main())

tasks.contract: Format frames carrying a plain variable then a callable, in order. Visibility filtering must fetch the value, gate callability, then classify. The bug gates on a value fetched later so any callable variable raises.
tasks.body:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, textwrap
probe = textwrap.dedent('''
    import sys
    import stackprinter
    def inner(cb):
        raise ValueError('callable-var')
    def outer():
        plain = 1
        inner(len)
    try:
        outer()
    except ValueError:
        out = stackprinter.format(sys.exc_info())
    has_plain = 'plain' in out
    has_len = 'len' in out
    print('visibility', has_plain, has_len)
    assert has_plain and has_len, out[-1500:]
''')
fd, p = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.py')
os.write(fd, probe.encode())
os.close(fd)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, p], capture_output=True, text=True)
os.unlink(p)
print(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout.strip() else 'no-probe-output')
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-1000:]
assert 'visibility True True' in r.stdout, r.stdout[-500:]
